title: Viral DNA Extraction and NGS Sample Prep
author: Miguel Chuapoco
materials: Air dry pellet and resuspend in 84 µL, PCR clean water UltraPure Distilled Water Invitrogen - Thermo Fisher Catalog #10977-015

steps.title: Animal Preparation and Injection
steps.instruction: Raise and house marmosets in compliance with local IACUC and ethical committees. For adult marmosets, ensure no detectable neutralizing antibodies for AAV9 (e.g., via The Penn Vector Core).

substeps.instruction: Inject marmosets intravenously (e.g., via femoral vein) with the desired dose of library (e.g., 2 x 10^12 vector genomes).

steps.title: Tissue Collection and Storage
steps.instruction: At four weeks post-injection, euthanize marmosets and perfuse with 1X phosphate buffered saline.

substeps.instruction: Flash freeze tissue (e.g., using 2-methylbutane chilled with dry ice).
Separate the brain into coronal blocks and flash freeze the blocks.
Store tissue at -80 ºC until processing.

steps.title: Tissue Homogenization
steps.instruction: Add 100 mg of tissue sample (brain, liver, or spinal cord) and 1 mL TRIzol reagent (Thermo Fisher Scientific #15596026) to bead homogenizer tubes.

substeps.instruction: Use prefilled 2.0ml tubes with either 1.5 mm Zirconium beads (Benchmark Scientific D1032-15) or 2.8 mm stainless steel beads (Benchmark Scientific D1033-28).
Homogenize using a BEADBUG 6 or BEADBLASTER 24 with settings: Speed 5.0 m/s, Time 30 seconds, Pause 1 minute, Cycles 2.
Incubate for 00:05:00.
Note: Samples can be stored at -20 ºC for up to a year in TRIzol.

steps.title: Phase Separation and Nucleic Acid Extraction
steps.instruction: Separate the nucleic acid phase from the protein phase using chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge homogenizer tubes at 12000 x g, 4 °C for 5 minutes using a refrigerated microcentrifuge (e.g., Eppendorf 5425/5425 R) and transfer supernatant to a new DNA LoBind tube (Eppendorf 022431021).
Add 600 µL chloroform for every 1 mL TRIzol used, vortex briefly, and incubate for 00:03:00.
Centrifuge at 12000 x g, 4 °C for 15 minutes.
Transfer the top aqueous phase (approximately 500 µL) to a new DNA LoBind tube.

steps.title: Nucleic Acid Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the nucleic acids from the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 equivalent volume of isopropanol (e.g., 500 µL), 1/10 volume of sodium acetate (3M, pH 5.2, Thermo Scientific #R1181) (e.g., 50 µL), and co-precipitant (e.g., GlycoBlue™ Thermo Scientific #AM9516, 2-3 µL).
Vortex briefly and incubate for 00:10:00.
Centrifuge at 12000 x g, 4 °C for 10 minutes to pellet nucleic acids.
Discard supernatant and wash pellet with 1 mL 75% ethanol.
Centrifuge again at 7500 x g, 4 °C for 5 minutes and discard supernatant.

steps.title: RNA Digestion
steps.instruction: Remove RNA from the sample via enzymatic digestion.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 µL RNase cocktail (Thermo Fisher #AM2286) and 3 µL SmaI (NEB #R0141S).
Supplement the reaction with 10 µL CutSmart Buffer (NEB #B7204S).
Incubate at room temperature for 2-3 hours and then at 37 °C overnight.

steps.title: DNA Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the resulting DNA using Zymo DNA Clean & Concentrator-5 (Zymo Research #D4014).

steps.title: First Round PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the region around the diversified genome insertion using Q5 High-Fidelity DNA Polymerase (NEB #M0491L) and 50% of the total extracted viral DNA as a template.

substeps.instruction: Use primers XF (ACTCATCGACCAATACTTGTACTATCTCTCTAGAAC) and 588-R2lib-R (GTATTCCTTGGTTTTGAACCCAACCG).
Perform 25 cycles: 98 °C for 00:00:10, 60 °C for 00:00:30, and 72 °C for 00:30:00.

steps.title: Second Round PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Perform a second round of PCR amplification around the variable region using Q5 High-Fidelity DNA Polymerase (NEB #M0491L).

substeps.instruction: Dilute the first PCR product 1:100 to use as a template.
Use primers 588i-lib-PCR1-6bpUID-F (CACTCATCGACCAATACTTGTACTATCTCTCT) and 588i-lib-PCR1-R (GTATTCCTTGGTTTTGAACCCAACCG).
Perform 10 cycles: 98 °C for 00:00:10, 59 °C for 00:00:30, and 72 °C for 00:00:10.

steps.title: Post-PCR Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the PCR products using Zymo DNA Clean & Concentrator-5 (Zymo Research #D4014).

steps.title: Illumina Adapter Addition
steps.instruction: Append Illumina flow cell adapters and unique indices via PCR amplification using Q5 High-Fidelity DNA Polymerase (NEB #M0491L) and NEBNext Multiplex Oligos for Illumina (Dual Index Primers Set 1, NEB #E7600S).

substeps.instruction: Perform 10 cycles: 98 °C for 00:00:10, 59 °C for 00:00:30, and 72 °C for 00:00:10.

steps.title: Gel Verification and Extraction
steps.instruction: Run PCR products on a freshly-prepared 2% UltraPure™ Low Melting Point Agarose gel (Thermo Fisher Scientific #16520050).

substeps.instruction: Verify the expected size of the band and extract the DNA from the gel.

steps.title: Optional Sanger Sequencing QC
steps.instruction: If desired, verify nucleotide diversity at the randomized insertion site by Sanger sequencing.

substeps.instruction: If more material is needed, perform additional PCR amplification (15-20 cycles: 98 °C for 00:00:10, 60 °C for 00:00:30, and 72 °C for 00:00:10) using primers NGS-QC-F (AATGATACGGCGACCACCGAG) and NGS-QC-R (CAAGCAGAAGACGGCATACGA).
